title: Sunburn Beach Arena Goa 2025
excerpt: A legendary sunset-to-midnight seaside journey with 55,000 festivalgoers and the global debut of the 'Feel The Spark' anthem.
description: Performing on the main stage as dusk settled over the Arabian Sea, Dj G-spark delivered a 3.5-hour masterclass in progressive melodic techno and high-energy bass. Over 200 pyro drones coordinated above the crowd, syncing with the bass drops.
highlights: Premiere of 'Ignite The Night' Live VIP Mix
tracklist: 01. Dj G-spark - Feel The Spark (Intro VIP)

title: Ultra Music Festival Miami 2025
excerpt: Closing headline performance on the iconic Worldwide Stage under a canopy of 32 synchronized multi-color lasers.
description: Dj G-spark commanded Bayfront Park with relentless 135 BPM energy. The set drew the largest crowd in the history of the Worldwide Stage, with a broadcast that reached 4.5 million fans across YouTube and SiriusXM.
highlights: Largest crowd in Worldwide Stage history
Billboard Dance 'Top 3 Sets of Miami Music Week'

title: Tomorrowland Freedom Stage 2024
excerpt: A visual masterpiece featuring custom 3D Holosphere projection mapping that redefined the indoor festival experience.
description: Widely voted one of the most innovative audio-visual sets of Tomorrowland 2024. The Freedom Stage was transformed into an interactive holographic hypercube responding directly to Dj G-spark's turntable manipulations.
highlights: Recognized by DJ Mag as Top Visual Set 2024

title: Delhi Arena Homecoming Showcase 2024
excerpt: A triumphant sold-out arena homecoming show celebrating Dj G-spark's #1 global streaming milestone.
description: 28,000 die-hard fans packed the IGI Stadium for a non-stop 4-hour musical journey with full stadium pyrotechnics, moving truss ceiling, and surprise vocal collaborators.
highlights: First Indian electronic artist with full moving ceiling rig
Official live album recorded on venue
tracklist: 03. Dj G-spark - Pulse of the Capital

title: Dubai Skyline Showcase 2023
excerpt: A glittering night in the desert with luxury production, laser canopy, and VIP superyacht afterparty.
description: Dj G-spark electrified the UAE with an unreleased setlist featuring Middle Eastern melodic scales woven into heavy driving techno basslines.
highlights: Highest grossing indoor electronic set in UAE 2023

title: Amsterdam ADE Warehouse Marathon 2023
excerpt: An intimate, raw 8-hour industrial warehouse marathon set hailed by European critics.
description: Stripped of conventional spectacle, the Gashouder warehouse was filled with raw concrete reverberation, monochrome strobes, and relentless dark techno groove.
highlights: Critical acclaim across European dance press
tracklist: 01. Dj G-spark - Gashouder Protocol (Live Marathon Mix)
